info.name: Rodha Email Verification & Soft Block
info.description:
Student email verification OTP + soft-block messaging for Website and Rodha Buddy.

**Captured from local DB/API** (`localhost:5000`, student `email.verify.docs@rodha.local`).

Use environment **Rodha Local** (`{{baseUrl}}` = `http://localhost:5000/rodha/`).

**Run order:** 00 Auth → 01 Admin settings → 02 Student OTP → 03 Me / soft → 04 Soft-block examples.

**FE docs:** `docs/FE_EMAIL_VERIFICATION_WEBSITE.md`, `docs/FE_EMAIL_VERIFICATION_BUDDY.md`.

exec: if (json.data?.roles?.length && typeof json.data.roles[0] === 'object') { const r = json.data.roles.find(x => x.name === 'admin') || json.data.roles[0]; pm.collectionVariables.set('roleId', String(r.id)); }
